## Account Usage: refresh when you need it
- Add **Refresh** to the Account Usage detail panel; opening the panel also refreshes older or failed readings when permitted. - Fix normal 15-minute polling gaps incorrectly appearing as **Stale**. Freshness now follows the reporting worker's cadence (34 minutes by default); actual read failures still mark data stale immediately. - Show the last successful update time and actionable sign-in, read-failure and rate-limit status. Failed reads keep the last known numbers; quota-reset times remain distinct from refresh/retry timing. - Prefer healthy replicas when an account is shared by several computers, without querying every duplicate device. Explicit device details retain that device's own status. - Keep concurrent-request coalescing, one-minute cooldowns and provider `Retry-After`. Refresh can return cached data during backoff; it does not bypass provider limits.
Includes **Tentacle 0.35.12**. Standalone computers also need Tentacle 0.35.12 for the new refresh capability; older workers continue to display cached readings. No Head update is required.
The shared native implementation covers Mac and iOS. This build also retains the chat-table and voice-composer updates already integrated in main.
Implementation and validation: https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/404

## What's Changed * feat(clients): redesigned chat tables on iOS and Mac; bare URLs become links by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/401
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/compare/mac-v0.2.66...mac-v0.2.67

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/compare/v0.35.8...mac-v0.2.66
